root_cause: Growth Swarm had twenty catalog plays but seven were ARMED/READY_FOR_SURFACE rather than end-to-end executable. Persuasion could also become a recommendation-only layer unless every decision had an executor path.
decision: Activate all 20 plays and introduce an ethical Persuasion Revenue Optimizer whose output is routed into canonical email, LinkedIn, content/SEO, benchmark, scan and portal executors.

runtime_evidence.explanation: No eligible email action existed at the activation instant; executor remains armed and routes automatically once existing evidence/suppression/cooldown gates pass.

prevention: A persuasion score or message strategy is never terminal; safe eligible actions must route into an executor.
Never use sensitive-trait or psychological personality profiling for persuasion.
Never fabricate scarcity, urgency, authority, testimonials, benchmarks or financial impact.
Keep no-buy, wait and self-fix as real options where evidence does not support purchase.
Optimize on reply, meeting, scan, paid order and realized revenue, with a measurement floor before declaring a winner.
Reuse canonical Powerhouse executors and outcome lineage; never create an isolated persuasion CRM.
